title: In The Year 2000!: Teleport-A-Phone Cryptex
blurb: A laser-cut cryptex with four hollow rings of digits. Dial the year the game is named for and the core slides out, with room inside for a note.

kit.title: In The Year 2000!: Teleport-A-Phone Cryptex
kit.summary: A laser-cut cryptex for a Glowforge, 1/8 in plywood or MDF. Four stepped rings of digits; dial the year and the hollow core slides out. Fits 2 sheets of 12x12.
